question: 不同地区用户分布情况
gold_sql: select r.region_name, count(distinct u.user_id) from users u left join regions r on u.region_id = r.region_id group by 1
raw_output:
SELECT r.region_name, COUNT(u.user_id) AS user_count
FROM users u
JOIN regions r ON u.region_id = r.region_id
GROUP BY r.region_name
ORDER BY user_count DESC;
